cards.card_text: Job says God is the Maker of the Bear, Orion and the Pleiades.
cards.verse_text: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, of the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.
cards.snippet: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, of the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.

cards.card_text: Now the LORD turns to the sky: can Job bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?
cards.verse_text: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?
cards.snippet: …you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?

cards.card_text: Then comes a picture of who the LORD is: He made the Pleiades and Orion.
cards.verse_text: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns darkness into dawn and darkens day into night, who summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth—the LORD is His name—
cards.snippet: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns darkness into dawn and darkens day into night, who summons…

cards.card_text: True or false: The One who made the Pleiades and Orion also summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth.
